chunks: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim and Jamil ibn Darraj and Sa'd ibn Abi Khalaf, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him).
Regarding a woman who has a servant girl who has reached puberty and needs her milk, he said: 'Order her to wean her, the milk will become pure (halal).'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a woman breastfeeding from her adult female servant?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* addresses the fiqh of 'milk of the adult' (laban al-baligh), ruling that a woman’s milk becomes permissible for consumption if she is weaned or 'purified' (tuhallil), likely referring to the cessation of lactation or a specific ritual act. It highlights the Shia juristic view on the purity of bodily fluids from non-nursing adults, distinguishing it from the milk of infants used for establishing kinship (radha'). The ruling underscores the practical application of purity laws in domestic settings where wet nurses were common.
